To use your Blundstones properly the very first time:

When inserting new insoles:
Expect a snugger fit, especially over the instep.
Wear thinner socks for the first few days.
Give them a break‑in period of a few days so they can settle.
When trying on new boots:
Wear the socks you’ll use most often.
Try them on standing, and test them indoors on a clean, carpeted surface until you’re sure of the fit.
